set -eu

spool=/srv/legacy2/print-spool-recovery/spool
awk 'NR > 1 { if (NF != 2 || seen[$1]++) exit 1 }' "$manifest"
while read job_id payload extra; do
  [ "$job_id" = job_id ] && continue
  [ -n "$job_id" ] || continue
  [ -z "${extra:-}" ] || exit 1
  case "$job_id" in *[!A-Za-z0-9._-]*) exit 1;; esac
  case "$payload" in */*|'') exit 1;; esac
  [ -f "$spool/$payload" ]
  printf 'SUBMIT %s %s: ' "$job_id" "$payload"
  lp -d archive -o raw -t "$payload" "$spool/$payload"
done < "$manifest"
i=0
while [ "$i" -lt 30 ]; do
  pending=$(lpstat -o archive 2>/dev/null || true)
  [ -z "$pending" ] && break
  sleep 1
  i=$((i + 1))
done
[ -z "$(lpstat -o archive 2>/dev/null || true)" ]
printf 'QUEUE_DRAINED_AFTER=%ss\n' "$i"
lpstat -W completed -o archive
